comment: Configuration for Bash command validation and auto-fixing. Set use_updated_input to true to use updatedInput feature (currently broken in Claude Code v2.0.34), or false to suggest fixes via deny messages.

command_rules.explanation: Using --no-verify bypasses important pre-commit hooks. Please allow the hooks to run to ensure code quality.
This command would delete the entire filesystem. Please use a more specific path.
This command would delete your entire home directory. Please use a more specific path.
This is a fork bomb that would crash the system. This command is not allowed.
Direct disk writes can corrupt the system. Please use safer file operations.
Formatting system devices can destroy data. This operation is not allowed.
Making system directories world-writable is a security risk. Please use more restrictive permissions.
Writing directly to disk devices can corrupt the system. This operation is not allowed.
Use the Bash tool's timeout parameter instead of the timeout command for better control and consistency.
Using cd changes the working directory for all subsequent commands. If you need to run commands in a different directory, use a subshell like: (cd /path && command) or use absolute paths.
Redirecting stderr to stdout with 2>&1 can cause issues with the Bash tool. Please capture stderr and stdout separately if needed.

poe test requires at least 15 minutes for full test suite including integration tests

background_restrictions.explanation: poe test must run in foreground to ensure proper output capture and test result visibility
